Copy the consecutive sentences from the submission through the failure."}, {"id": "draft-2", "source": "status-639", "description": "Separate draft sponsor, text and failed tally. Copy all consecutive sentences through the final tally."}, {"id": "co-sponsor-reason", "source": "french-uae", "description": "First sentence of the UAE's explanation of the shared rationale."}, {"id": "russia-reason", "source": "russia", "description": "First sentence stating Russia's concern about the existing approach."}], "evidence": {"status-638": "France and the United Arab Emirates submitted S/2023/638. It proposed renewing the sanctions and extending the Panel of Experts. The tally was 13 in favour, 1 against and 1 abstention. Russia cast the sole negative vote and the draft was not adopted due to the negative vote of a permanent member. France supported it and China abstained.", "status-639": "Russia submitted S/2023/639 as a separate draft. It proposed a final extension of the sanctions and immediate dissolution of the Panel of Experts. Russia voted in favour, Japan against and all other members including France and China abstained. It was not adopted, having received 1 vote in favour, 1 against and 13 abstentions.", "french-uae": "The United Arab Emirates said it and France sought an extension to support implementation of the peace agreement and an orderly drawdown. It acknowledged the transitional Government's request to lift the sanctions and said the draft allowed review of the continuation of the measures.", "russia": "Russia said the existing approach had not addressed the concerns of Mali's transitional Government. It proposed dissolving the Panel of Experts and making this the final extension of the regime.", "france-after": "France regretted the veto and said Russia's separate proposal had not been discussed by Council members. It presented the implementation of the peace agreement as an urgent concern."}}
